PR #1 qualification: the complete landing gate passed on 98b9eb2b65f96c39ebbe0e9728702bf15c26f021, tree a7b49bb3cac051c569f90af5f8e9c8a30c7cd4ef, including hygiene, strict compilation, API audit (3672 runtime entries / 540 abstractions / zero uncovered), testAll, boundaries and 207 JVM / 195 JS artifact-consumer tests. Logs and consumer receipt are preserved under /private/tmp/eyes4s-family-pr/target/landing-gate/before-main-sync.
Merged independently qualified main 9431e120 into 50daefab180b154cc8b4563a2bf11437bd52bc66, tree dd3bcfa08823636ed168174dcda0d9acb09b4528. Incoming library edits are Scaladoc-only (53 files, zero changed non-comment lines), with consumer/bundle-probe/doc tooling and no Studio changes. This merge passed hygiene, strict compilation and checkBoundaries. Its API re-record was intentionally stopped when CI failures required additional test/build changes; no completed audit is claimed for the interrupted run.
CI completed after the explicit desktop fork heap fix. Intel macOS exposed native journey timeouts and later timing failures; Linux passed native archive journeys but exposed a snapshot layout race and a separate native-report startup timeout across its two runs. The snapshot now waits for layout and a frame with the host's current dimensions. The intended CI adjustment retains the original Apple Silicon runner and gives its test fork 5 GB / sbt 2 GB, leaving Linux's 8 GB test fork / sbt 3 GB.
A headless local probe with a 5 GB fork, 2 GB sbt and three active processors passed all 13 NativeCommandJourneySuite, NativeGoldenCommandFxSuite, NativeWindowFxSuite, SourceRecordsFxSuite and SourceRepairFileFxSuite tests. Native command journey: 218.057 s (unchanged 300 s cap); native window journey: 377.533 s (unchanged 600 s cap); native report window: 50.948 s. Scrolling: median 16.3 ms (unchanged 32 ms cap), worst 66.9 ms. No scientific assertions, fixture sizes or timing budgets were changed. Logs: target/landing-gate/desktop-5g.log and desktop-5g-gc.log.
The slice remains in review until landing. The updated committed candidate will receive fresh API evidence and final GitHub CI before the PR is declared ready. No main merge is requested by this PR-readiness task.
